highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.156 release improves managed and HarfBuzz performance while refining native platform support.
highlights_body: It reduces allocation during pixel copying and text shaping, packages WebGPU support with the native library, and improves Android rendering synchronization.

bullets.detail: Coordinates Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother presentation.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily
bullets.detail: Releases retained front-buffered stream data correctly to reduce avoidable memory use.

bullets.lead: Managed image and shaping allocations reduced
bullets.detail: Optimizes image pixel copies, feature-string decoding, and HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding to reduce allocation pressure in common managed workloads.

bullets.lead: WebGPU support packaged with the native library
bullets.detail: Includes emdawnwebgpu's WebGPU implementation in libSkiaSharp.a so consumers receive the required native support with the library.
Updates the minimum supported Apple deployment targets for the upcoming release.
Binds bundled HarfBuzz functions locally so Linux native artifacts use the packaged implementation consistently.

contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Bundled HarfBuzz function binding on Linux and Blazor CPU sample-test stabilization
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebGPU implementation packaging in the native SkiaSharp library
